summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found four US-listed companies with plausible direct or second-order exposure to student-loan servicing, education payments, and compliance-heavy higher-education financial infrastructure. Nelnet is the clearest direct public asset because it reports Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payments segments. Flywire is a focused education-payments and student-financial-software platform with university payment and past-due tuition workflows. SLM is a direct private education-loan originator/servicer, but its exposure is more credit-cycle and funding-cost driven than pure servicing infrastructure. Global Payments is a large-cap context/hidden-subsidiary candidate through Heartland ECSI, a higher-education student-loan servicing and campus payment platform; the node relevance is strong but likely diluted at the parent-company level. Expanded the universe around regulated student-finance operating infrastructure rather than obvious online-learning operators. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are Nelnet for direct loan servicing plus education payments, Flywire for university tuition/payment workflow infrastructure, and Maximus for federal student-loan servicing via Aidvantage. SLM is included as a reference/private-student-loan anchor because it is directly exposed to origination/servicing economics but is less of a pure third-party infrastructure supplier.
